news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year-Over-Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 revenue rose 116% year-over-year to $1.93M at 85.9% gross margin, the eighth straight quarter of double-digit growth as the January Category I CPT code kept widening reimbursement. Cash stood at $8.3M with quarterly operating cash burn down to $1.0M, though auditors' going-concern qualification remains in place.

news.headline: Earnings Call Transcript: NeurAxis Falls on Q2 2026 EPS Miss Despite 116% Revenue Growth
news.summary: Shares dropped about 7% to $6.40 after Q2 EPS of -$0.19 missed the -$0.16 consensus even though revenue topped growth expectations. Management said second-half operating expenses will rise as the company invests in sales, marketing and clinical staff to chase the next round of payer wins.

news.headline: NeurAxis (NRXS): Q2 2026 Earnings Review
news.summary: Independent review highlighted average selling price up 28% YoY to $992 (nearing the $1,195 list-price ceiling), prior-authorization approval up to 31% YTD from 12% a year ago, and plans to have 10 commission-only VA territory reps operational by mid-September as a Q4 volume catalyst. Management said it is cautiously optimistic about a major new payer coverage win in H2 2026 or early 2027.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: New medical policies from additional insurers added more than 500,000 covered lives for PENFS/IB-Stim in the Mid-Atlantic region. The expansion continued the post-CPT-code push to widen the reimbursed patient base just ahead of the Q2 print.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it would report Q2 2026 results and host a business-update conference call on August 11 at 9:00am ET. The announcement set the date for what turned into a closely watched print on reimbursement-driven growth.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 2026 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: The board declared its Q2 2026 stock dividend on the Series B Preferred, paid July 29 to holders of record July 21, with common shares issued at accrued unpaid dividends divided by $2.38. Routine non-cash preferred housekeeping that adds modest ongoing dilution rather than operational news.

catalysts.label: Major national payer coverage decision
catalysts.detail: Management says talks with two large commercial payers are progressing and it is 'cautiously optimistic' about a coverage win in H2 2026 or early 2027; the CEO called a single major payer add a potential 'slingshot run at profitability'.

catalysts.label: VA sales force fully staffed
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis plans to have 10 commission-only Veterans Affairs territory reps operational by mid-September 2026, aimed at accelerating VA-channel IB-Stim volume as a Q4 catalyst.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly report, expected around mid-November based on the company's quarterly cadence (Q1 on May 12, Q2 on Aug 11), will show whether 116% revenue growth, rising ASP ($992, nearing the $1,195 list-price ceiling) and lower cash burn are sustaining into H2.

catalysts.label: Covered-lives target above 200 million
catalysts.detail: The CEO said he would be 'highly disappointed' if PENFS/IB-Stim covered lives were not above 200 million by 2027, up from just over 100 million currently, implying continued payer-policy wins ahead.

pulse: NeurAxis's Q2 2026 print (Aug 11) confirmed the CPT-code reimbursement story is working - revenue up 116% YoY to $1.93M, ASP up 28% to $992, gross margin near 86%, and cash burn down to $1.0M on $8.3M of cash - but shares fell about 7% because EPS missed consensus and management flagged rising H2 opex as it invests in sales, marketing and clinical staff ahead of the next payer wins; the going-concern qualification also remains. An August 4 payer-coverage expansion (+500K Mid-Atlantic lives) kept the reimbursement drumbeat going into earnings, and no material company-specific news has emerged since the print through August 17. Watch for a decision from one of the two large commercial payers now in negotiation (H2 2026/early 2027), the mid-September VA sales-force buildout, and whether growth can keep outrunning the still-present dilution and going-concern risk.
